en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large Baroque water castle with round corner towers and a chapel-like wing, reflected in a surrounding pond or moat. Trees and a promenade line the water and several small figures walk along the path. The sky is cloudy and the card has the typical white, slightly deckled border of mid‑20th‑century postcards. At the bottom, a German caption identifies the site as a Baroque castle near Dresden.
